intro.text: Ring fingers next! S is under your left ring finger and L is under your right. They’re a bit shy, so they need extra practice.
intro.tip: If a ring finger feels wobbly, slow down. Accuracy builds the muscle memory.

steps.title: Meet S and L
steps.instructions: Press each key as it lights up. Take your time – the cursor waits for the right key.

steps.title: Guided drill
steps.text: sss lll sls lsl dsd klk sdf lkj fsl jls
steps.instructions: Keep your fingers on the home row and move only the finger you need.

steps.title: Mix it up
steps.instructions: The new keys are mixed with the ones you already know.

steps.title: Hands-on challenge
text: sl ls sld lsk fsl jls dsl kls sdf lkj slk lsd
steps.instructions: The keyboard hints fade out now – trust your fingers!
